items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: They have two bands, Faith Martha's Band and our band... I heard it. Yeah. He was with Faith Martha's Band when we were up there.

ctx.x: Anybody else want to ask? Where did you go with the Maple Leaf Band when you went out of town?

Well we went across the lake, went over to Manifel. We played over to Manifel in across the lake, Madison. Manifel, Madison. No, I mean on the St. Mount. Oh, well we didn't go up the river, I mean we used to play excursions. The evening excursions. They have two bands, Faith Martha's Band and our band. Like the meetings, like the picnics. Mm-hmm. But they had two bands. And the Maple Leaf Band had all that work on there, on the picnics. They had wanted the manager of the Maple Leaf Band to take the job to roughly…
What was Faith Martha's Band like then?
